activity_summary: You and Anne started along the field path with the children left at home. The stubble was short. She wanted the walking itself. You did not begin a speech.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked, stopped the tale, and did not add a word.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the land, heard the stop, and kept the pace of the horses plain.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: The walking is the part I came out for.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not starting a speech at a hedge.
